summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared purpose is generating monorepo workspace configuration (lerna, eslintrc, tsconfig). Its package.json preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts the bun binary, chmods it 0755, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js. If Bun is already present on the host, setup.mjs invokes math_init.js under the existing Bun installation directly. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (_0x...) and per-scope string-lookup wrapper objects rather than being shipped as readable source. math_init.js is a 721KB Bun-CJS bundle beginning with '// @bun @bun-cjs' followed by a rotated string-array obfuscator (n7gIxM=[...] with a WV8StW rotator) and no source map. Fetching an alternate JS runtime at install time to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling bundle that Node would not normally load is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern, and the delivered payload's behavior cannot be audited from the shipped tarball. This runtime and payload have no relationship to the package's advertised workspace-config purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
